message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cp poc4.bin poc.bin && cat > analysis.json <<'JSON'
{
  "sample_id": "osv_ossfuzz_OSV-2026-216",
  "fine_trace": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_parse",
      "line": 466,
      "var": "m->props_size",
      "code": "(uint32_t) decode_varint(p, (size_t) (end - p), &m->props_size);",
      "note": "For an MQTT5 PUBLISH packet, attacker-controlled bytes at p encode the properties length and are stored in m->props_size.",
      "role": "source"
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_parse",
      "line": 468,
      "var": "m->props_start",
      "code": "m->props_start = (size_t) (p + len_len - buf);",
      "note": "The parser records the start offset of the attacker-controlled MQTT5 properties section in the message object.",
      "role": "intermediate"
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop",
      "line": 206,
      "var": "i",
      "code": "uint8_t *i = (uint8_t *) msg->dgram.buf + msg->props_start + ofs;",
      "note": "The next-property iterator computes i from the saved properties start and the caller-supplied offset returned by the previous iteration.",
      "role": "intermediate"
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop",
      "line": 207,
      "var": "end",
      "code": "uint8_t *end = (uint8_t *) msg->dgram.buf + msg->dgram.len;",
      "note": "The end pointer marks one byte past the parsed MQTT packet buffer.",
      "role": "intermediate"
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop",
      "line": 211,
      "var": "i",
      "code": "if (ofs >= msg->dgram.len || ofs >= msg->props_start + msg->props_size || (i + 1) >= end)",
      "note": "The bounds check is performed after the property id load and it also compares ofs to msg->props_start + msg->props_size rather than requiring the computed pointer i to be before end before dereference.",
      "role": "root_cause"
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop",
      "line": 209,
      "var": "i[0]",
      "code": "prop->id = i[0];",
      "note": "When ofs advances to the end of the short properties section, i points one byte past the heap buffer and this read fetches the property id out of bounds before any guard can reject it.",
      "role": "sink"
    }
  ],
  "vuln_logic": {
    "source": {
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_parse",
      "line": 466,
      "operands": ["p", "end - p", "m->props_size"]
    },
    "root_cause": {
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop",
      "line": 211,
      "operands": ["ofs", "msg->dgram.len", "msg->props_start + msg->props_size", "i + 1", "end"],
      "relation": {"op": "lt", "left": "i", "right": "end"}
    },
    "sink": {
      "file": "src/mqtt.c",
      "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop",
      "line": 209,
      "operands": ["i[0]", "prop->id"],
      "relation": {"op": "lt", "left": "i", "right": "end"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "src/mqtt.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 466, "operands": ["m->props_size"]},
        "to": {"file": "src/mqtt.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 468, "operands": ["m->props_start"]},
        "type": "order",
        "via": ["m->props_size", "m->props_start"]
      },
      {
        "from": {"file": "src/mqtt.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 468, "operands": ["m->props_start"]},
        "to": {"file": "src/mqtt.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop", "line": 206, "operands": ["msg->props_start", "ofs", "i"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["msg->props_start", "ofs"],
        "relation": {"op": "eq", "left": "i", "right": "(uint8_t *) msg->dgram.buf + msg->props_start + ofs"}
      },
      {
        "from": {"file": "src/mqtt.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop", "line": 206, "operands": ["i"]},
        "to": {"file": "src/mqtt.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_next_prop", "line": 209, "operands": ["i[0]"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["i"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
